scope: Development diagnostic on previously inspected PRONTO records. Fixed before new band runs. Context and length change together; no causal or prospective performance claim.
criterion: Three consecutive any-tag flags at or after the labelled onset and at most 0.5% of common pre-fault rows flagged. K-target failure is reported separately, never hidden.
row_convention: Zero-based merged data rows, half-open intervals. Every fit and K-selection record precedes the identical score bytes used by both choices. No burn-in is discarded.
excluded: Do not pool disjoint Normal blocks: the filter treats successive rows as adjacent across gaps. No thresholds, constants, tags, source labels, matrix criteria or defaults may be tuned from these results.
limits: Recent means a shorter retrospective labelled-normal candidate, not a verified matching operating mode. Preserve all outcomes. The four original full-score controls have different pre-fault populations and are not the paired comparison. N056 remains open for a qualified longer multi-day baseline.
